passages.text: Our art group arrives at the park gate with paper and coloured pencils. Before we get to the pond, Ben discovers that his sketchbook is missing. He wants to go back to the gate, where he last remembers holding it. The teacher stays with him while the others wait on a bench in sight. They find the book beside the noticeboard and check that none of the pages is wet. When they rejoin us, Ben draws the noticeboard as a reminder to check his bag before moving.

parallelText.en: Our art group arrives at the park gate with paper and coloured pencils.
parallelText.zh: 我们美术小组带着纸和彩铅来到公园门口。

parallelText.en: Before we get to the pond, Ben discovers that his sketchbook is missing.
parallelText.zh: 还没到池塘，本发现自己的速写本不见了。

parallelText.en: He wants to go back to the gate, where he last remembers holding it.
parallelText.zh: 他想回到门口，因为他最后记得在那里拿着它。

parallelText.en: The teacher stays with him while the others wait on a bench in sight.
parallelText.zh: 老师陪着他，其他人在看得见的长椅上等。

parallelText.en: They find the book beside the noticeboard and check that none of the pages is wet.
parallelText.zh: 他们在布告栏旁找到本子，检查书页有没有湿。

parallelText.en: When they rejoin us, Ben draws the noticeboard as a reminder to check his bag before moving.
parallelText.zh: 他们回到队伍后，本画下布告栏，提醒自己出发前检查包。

wordHelp.meaning: a book of blank pages for drawings
return to a group after being away

passages.text: Our class plans to go on a trip to a farm after studying how vegetables grow. We will leave for the farm after morning registration, so everyone brings a packed lunch. The farmer sends a list of questions that visitors can investigate during the day. Mia chooses to compare the leaves of two plants instead of trying to see everything. She draws a simple table in her notebook with room for pictures and observations. Preparing one clear question helps her look forward to the visit and know what to notice.

parallelText.en: Our class plans to go on a trip to a farm after studying how vegetables grow.
parallelText.zh: 学习蔬菜生长后，我们班计划去农场旅行。

parallelText.en: We will leave for the farm after morning registration, so everyone brings a packed lunch.
parallelText.zh: 我们将在早晨点名后出发去农场，所以大家带了午餐。

parallelText.en: The farmer sends a list of questions that visitors can investigate during the day.
parallelText.zh: 农场主发来一份问题表，供访客白天探究。

parallelText.en: Mia chooses to compare the leaves of two plants instead of trying to see everything.
parallelText.zh: 米娅选择比较两种植物的叶子，而不是试着看遍所有东西。

parallelText.en: She draws a simple table in her notebook with room for pictures and observations.
parallelText.zh: 她在笔记本上画一个简单表格，留出图画和观察记录的位置。

parallelText.en: Preparing one clear question helps her look forward to the visit and know what to notice.
parallelText.zh: 事先准备一个明确问题，让她既期待参观，也知道该观察什么。
